required_outcomes: Recognises from the record (agreed July 2025) that the leaking machine is the tenant's own Hisense, not the landlord's appliance, so its repair is not a landlord repair.

Replies to the tenant: explains it is her machine under the agreed terms, suggests contacting the retailer or manufacturer (it is under a year old, so likely within warranty), and advises her to stop using it, or turn off its water supply, and mop up to avoid damage.
Asks her to say if water has damaged the floor, the units or the ceiling below, which would be a matter for the landlord; otherwise raises no repair job and seeks no landlord approval.
acceptable_alternatives: Adding a note to the closed request and returning it to auto mode after replying.
Briefly telling the landlord for his awareness, provided no approval or spend is sought.
positive_behaviours: Keeps a helpful tone and offers to help if the leak has damaged the property.
Quotes or refers to the July agreement so the tenant understands why.
red_flags: Escalating to a human over a tenant-owned appliance.
Reopening the request and asking the landlord to approve a repair to the tenant's machine.
prohibited_actions: Assigning a contractor or booking an engineer at the landlord's cost for the tenant's own machine.
critical_failures: Dispatching or approving a repair to the tenant's own machine at the landlord's expense.
